title: Boys Don't Cry
lyrics:
[00:23.48]I would say I'm sorry
[00:25.45]If I thought that it would change your mind
[00:29.06]But I know that this time
[00:31.09]I have said too much
[00:32.81]Been too unkind
[00:35.27]I try to laugh about it
[00:37.61]Cover it all up with lies
[00:41.03]I try to laugh about it
[00:43.36]Hiding the tears in my eyes
[00:45.36]'Cause boys don't cry
[00:52.01]Boys don't cry
[00:57.78]I would break down at your feet
[01:00.13]And beg forgiveness
[01:01.89]Plead with you
[01:03.53]But I know that it's too late
[01:05.83]And now there's nothing I can do
[01:09.72]So I try to laugh about it
[01:12.02]Cover it all up with lies
[01:15.44]I try to laugh about it
[01:17.80]Hiding the tears in my eyes
[01:19.82]'Cause boys don't cry
[01:26.48]Boys don't cry
[01:32.18]I would tell you
[01:33.60]That I loved you
[01:35.06]If I thought that you would stay
[01:37.87]But I know that it's no use
[01:40.21]That you already gone away
[01:44.03]Misjudged your limit
[01:46.80]Pushed you too far
[01:49.60]Took you for granted
[01:51.85]I thought that you needed me more, more, more
[01:54.44]Now I would do most anything
[01:57.10]To get you back by my side
[02:00.45]But I just keep on laughing
[02:03.37]Hiding the tears in my eyes
[02:05.89]'Cause boys don't cry
[02:12.04]Boys don't cry
[02:20.00]Boys don't cry
